description: This file declares the TriggerSimulaturHelper class and related functions for simulating trigger signals based on trigger shapes, primarily used in a firmware project related to engine control.

classes.name: TriggerStimulatorHelper
classes.description: A helper class for generating synthetic shaft signals based on trigger shapes, providing methods to find synchronization points and simulate trigger events.

methods.name: findTriggerSyncPoint
methods.description: Identifies the synchronization point in a trigger shape based on the current trigger state.

methods.name: assertSyncPositionAndSetDutyCycle
methods.description: Sets the synchronization position and duty cycle for the trigger simulation.

methods.name: feedSimulatedEvent
methods.description: Feeds a simulated trigger event into the current trigger state.
